name: moon-guard
description: MoonTerminal's shell rules and live counters: refuses cargo builds without the MSVC target, the vcvars wrapper and a Cargo.lock committed under a [patch] path override; holds a push, a PR merge, a release, a discard of uncommitted work and a lock update with a preview until the person confirms; /diag shows render_diag.log as it is written.

hold.title: Hold risky commands
hold.description: Hold git push, gh pr merge, releases, git reset --hard / checkout -- / restore / clean -f, and cargo update until you press Proceed (or type /proceed); unanswered in 2 minutes, the command is refused with its preview
